title: 第19章资源耗尽
novel_title: 莫欺老年穷，一天增加一个天赋点
content_zh:
这番说辞，滴水不漏。

    既解释了为何无人知晓，又展现了自己不骄不躁、沉稳内敛的“大才之风”。

    秦虎最后一丝疑虑，瞬间烟消云散。

    他先是怔怔地看着林枫，随即，一股难以言喻的狂喜如火山般从胸腔中爆发！

    “好！好！好！”

    他一连说了三个好字，蒲扇般的大手重重拍在桌案上，震得整座内堂都嗡嗡作响。

    “哈哈哈哈！不骄不躁，胜而不骄！这才是真正的麒麟儿！我秦虎，当真是捡到天大的宝贝了！”

    秦虎的笑声充满了无与伦比的骄傲与畅快。

    他激动地一把抓住林枫的肩膀。

    下一刻，秦虎再无半分犹豫，直接从怀里掏出一个沉甸甸的锦囊和一只温润的白玉盒，看也不看就塞进了林枫的手中。

    “这里是五十两黄金！拿去买你需要的任何东西，不必节省！”

    “这玉盒里，是一株货真价实的百年血参！足以让你根基再上一层楼，早日冲破气血狼烟！”

    “从今日起，镖局武库三层以下，对你全面开放！任何功法武技，任你挑选！”

    一连串的重赏，砸得林枫脑子都有些发懵，紧接着便是无边的狂喜。

    他强压下心中的激动，恭敬拜倒：“多谢师父厚爱！弟子定不负师父所望！”

    此刻林枫也管不到那个能够打出六百公斤的狠人了，在林枫看来，自己有着上中根骨，再加上有着秦虎的助力。

    迟早能够在气血关打出六百公斤的力量，等到了那个时候，谁也说不得什么！

    狂喜过后，秦虎的目光变得愈发灼热，他扶起林枫，沉声道：“六百公斤之力，已不弱于寻常初入气血狼烟的武者！光说不练假把式，是时候让你出去见见真正的血了！”

    他踱了两步，眼中精光一闪。

    “三日后，有一趟送往隔壁青阳县的镖，路途不远，沿途也算太平。正好，就由你亲自带队，也算是我风云镖局的麒麟儿第一次亮相！”

    秦虎顿了顿，脸上露出一抹慈爱的笑容。

    “婉儿那丫头也大了，整天待在镖局里也不是个事。这次，就让她跟着你，去长长见识，也学学如何走镖。”

    由自己带队？

    还能与秦婉儿同行？

    林枫闻言大喜过望，这简直是天赐良机！

    不仅是他在镖局立威的机会，更是与秦婉儿朝夕相处、培养感情的绝佳时机！
content_en:
This rhetoric is watertight.

    It not only explains why no one knows about it, but also shows his "talented style" of being neither arrogant nor impetuous, calm and restrained.

    Qin Hu's last doubt disappeared in an instant.

    He first looked at Lin Feng blankly, and then, an indescribable ecstasy erupted from his chest like a volcano!

    "Okay! Okay! Okay!"

    He said three good words in a row, and slapped the table with his big palm-like hand, which made the whole inner hall buzz.

    "Hahahaha! Neither arrogant nor impetuous, winning without being arrogant! This is the real Qilin'er! I, Qin Hu, have really found a huge treasure!"

    Qin Hu's laughter was full of unparalleled pride and joy.

    He grabbed Lin Feng's shoulders excitedly.

    The next moment, Qin Hu didn't hesitate at all. He took out a heavy brocade bag and a warm white jade box from his arms, and stuffed them into Lin Feng's hands without looking at them.

    "Here are fifty taels of gold! Use it to buy whatever you need, no need to save!"

    "In this jade box, there is a genuine century-old blood ginseng! It is enough to improve your foundation to a higher level and break through the qi-blood war smoke as soon as possible!"

    "From today on, the escort agency's arsenal below the third floor is fully open to you! You can choose any martial arts or skills!"

    A series of heavy rewards made Lin Feng a little confused, followed by boundless ecstasy.

    He suppressed the excitement in his heart and bowed respectfully: "Thank you Master for your love! I will definitely live up to Master's expectations!"

    At this moment, Lin Feng couldn't care about the ruthless man who could hit 600 kilograms. In Lin Feng's view, he had upper and middle bones, plus Qin Hu's help.

    Sooner or later, I will be able to exert a force of 600 kilograms at the Qi and Blood Pass. When that time comes, no one can say anything!

    After the ecstasy, Qin Hu's eyes became more intense. He helped Lin Feng up and said in a deep voice: "With a force of six hundred kilograms, it is no longer weaker than an ordinary warrior who has just entered the Qi and Blood Wolf Smoke! Just talk and don't practice fake moves. It's time for you to go out and see the real blood!"

    He took two steps and his eyes flashed.

    "Three days later, there will be an escort sent to Qingyang County next door. The journey is not far and the journey is considered peaceful. Just in time, you will lead the team in person. It can also be regarded as the first appearance of Qilin'er from my Fengyun Escort Agency!"

    Qin Hu paused, with a loving smile on his face.

    "That girl, Wan'er, is too old to stay in the escort agency all day long. This time, let her follow you to gain experience and learn how to act as an escort."

    Leading the team yourself?

    Can I still go with Qin Wan'er?

    Lin Feng was overjoyed when he heard this, this was simply a God-sent opportunity!

    Not only is it an opportunity for him to establish his prestige in the escort agency, but it is also an excellent opportunity to spend time with Qin Wan'er and cultivate feelings!
